UPDATE room_playback_state
                     SET playing_media_id = NULL,
                         playing_playlist_id = NULL,
                         target = ''::bytea,
                         "current_time" = 0,
                         speed = 1.0,
                         is_playing = false,
                         version = version + 1,
                         updated_at = NOW()
                     WHERE room_id = $1
